0022600103.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-1, 14th in the West, 4th in the Pacific) are hosting the Portland Trail Blazers (1-0, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West) in their second game of the season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, ruptured), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision. Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Chris Youngblood is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet this season, and Portland won the four meetings in 2025-26, including a 122-110 win in Portland on April 12, 2026.
